turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

We allow 1-3 business days for orders to be fulfilled by our warehouse, plus an additional 4-8 business days for standard shipping—so your order should arrive within 5-11 business days. Most orders actually arrive on the shorter end of that window since our team works quickly, but we give this range just to be safe.

You can find all the details on our shipping information page if you’d like to check out more specifics!
